title: AMX common report definitions
description: Shapes shared by the AMA -> AMS report schemas (docs/AMX-DESIGN.md §6.5). Definitions here deliberately declare NO `required` list — each consuming schema states its own, because the same shape carries different obligations per report (a switch event names accounts by email alone, a usage report always has the AMS id too). Reference these with a sibling `required`, e.g. {"$ref": "common.schema.json#/$defs/accountRef", "required": ["email"]}.

agentId.description: Stable agent identifier assigned at enrollment.

accountRef.description: Account identity. The AMS<->AMA mapping key is email/uuid, never a tsamx slot number (§2.4-3).

provider.description: Account provider (P3). Absent or empty means "claude".

eligible.description: Active accounts below the switching threshold, i.e. usable switch candidates.

allExhausted.description: Every account is at or above the threshold (D10: 95%). Critical — AMS alerts and considers assigning more accounts (§6.4).
